newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Exploration placement reaches minimum.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Exploration placement reaches minimum.

text.p: United States Exploration Inc said Wednesday that as of September 30 it placed the minimum requirement of one million shares of its Series C preferred stock to certain current company shareholders.
The preferred was placed in keeping with terms of a private placement memorandum dated September 17.

President Demetrie Carone said the company expects to place the remaining three million shares by October 31. Financial details will be released on completion of the offering or filing of the company's next quarterly report.
United States Exploration is involved in exploration, development and production of oil and gas reserves.
